difficulty.label: Scarce Embers
difficulty.desc: Shrine rest and between-act healing are halved.

difficulty.label: Deadly Foes
difficulty.desc: Every enemy begins combat with +1 Strength.

difficulty.label: Cursed Start
difficulty.desc: Begin the run with a Guilt curse shuffled into your deck.

chaos.label: Elite Gauntlet
chaos.desc: Every monster node is an Elite fight.

chaos.label: Hoarder
chaos.desc: Start with +250 cinders — but every shop price doubles.

chaos.label: Chaos Rewards
chaos.desc: Card rewards ignore rarity: rares everywhere.

chaos.label: Glass Cannon
chaos.desc: You deal +25% damage, but take +25% damage.

chaos.label: Endless Spire
chaos.desc: After Act 3 the spire loops — each cycle, foes gain HP and Strength. Only death ends the climb.

deckModes.label: Sealed
deckModes.desc: A random starting deck drawn from your class pool.

deckModes.label: Draft
deckModes.desc: Draft your starting deck card by card.

mapShape.label: Run shape
mapShape.note: Share of the roll, not of the finished map — floor rules and the no-repeat-neighbour ban still override it.
